title: A font: res/fonts/<archive>/<font>/font.json
description: A font of ARCID_FONT (a/0/2/3), in Nitro's font format, which gf_font.c reads: its metrics, its character maps and its glyphs, whose pixels are the cells of glyphs.png beside it. tools/data/nitro_font.py builds the font from them for tools/data/graphics_archive.py, computing the blocks' offsets and sizes, the maps' contents and the widths block.

fontType.description: The font information's (FINF) type of font: 0 for a glyph font

lineFeed.description: The height of a line, which the game gives as every glyph's height (GFL_FontGetCharHeight)

alterCharIndex.description: The glyph for a character the font doesn't have, in the format; the game draws '?' instead

defaultCharWidth.description: The default advance, which a font loaded with fixed widths gives every glyph (GFL_FontGetCharWidthFixed), and the widths block gives a glyph it doesn't hold

cellWidth.description: The glyph cells' width in pixels, a cell of glyphs.png

cellHeight.description: The glyph cells' height in pixels

baseline.description: The baseline, from the cell's top

maxCharWidth.description: The widest advance, as the format records it; the game doesn't read it

bpp.description: Bits a pixel; the game draws 2

flags.description: The glyphs' flags (rotation), 0 in the game's fonts

classPadding.description: The bytes after the last glyph's class in the widths block, up to its hash table, where they aren't zeros: as the game's fonts have them

maps.description: The character maps (CMAP), in the order the game searches them; each takes the glyphs of its range's characters that no earlier map's range holds

method.description: direct: the range's characters are its first's glyph and those after it; table: a glyph for each character of the range; scan: pairs of a character and its glyph, in order

glyphs.description: The glyphs, in the order of glyphs.png's cells; each starts its cell with its left offset, width and advance, as GFL_FontGlyphCopy reads them

code.description: Its code, where the character doesn't print; the character must be the code's where both are given

left.description: Where the glyph's pixels start, from the pen

width.description: The width of the glyph's pixels

advance.description: How far the pen moves after the glyph (GFL_FontGetCharWidth)
